title: Audit the P104 kernel against its actual required X0 consumer
body:
## Current exact-head status (2026-10-19 UTC)

Current published head: `3088a09c77fe5353218df861e34b0fe67dbf1b6b`. Rechecked against GitHub; canonical main is `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f`, while the original scientific baseline remains `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`.

At this exact head:
- [Registered research packages](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39215141000): success
- [Community exact tooling and scoped audits](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39215141026): success
- [Historical reconciliation 92 integrity](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39215141014): success
- [r420-two-sided-basis](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39215141113): cancelled during checkout; not a passing replay. A prior rerun request was denied with HTTP 403 and has not been bypassed

This is a status/scope correction, not a new scientific validation. Earlier source ZIP/export hashes remain historical publication evidence, not a regenerated current-head export. Hosted checks do not establish independent scientific approval. The cancelled r420 run remains an explicit unresolved CI obligation.

## Problem and result

PR #3554 left two conditional handoffs: identify an actual physical provider of its coefficient interface, and identify a required legal readout of its five-readout kernel. This PR answers them with one source-bound consumer audit against the unchanged PR #2586 word.

The original coefficient witness `a44 = delta15` prepares `Y91 = p, Y90 = -p`. It fails the actual full-word contract at zero-based event **1099**, `D1 += Y90/4` in frame `[381,241,2]`. At address **10**, the donor is `(-2,0)`, requiring real increment **-1/2**. All 1,099 earlier events complete exactly, with no completed event output outside B9. This binds an actual omitted read, rather than merely failing a sufficient product-domain condition.

There is also an admitted observable family. For **every `u in B9`**, set `Y91 = 4u, Y90 = -4u` and all other initial public banks to zero. A written induction, supported by the complete scalar denominator certificate and credited native preservation/covariance, proves exact execution through all **5,398 events** and

$$\rho_5(y)=0,\qquad X0_{\mathrm{final}}=-2A_Fu.$$

Thus no function of the five readouts alone can supply this required X0 endpoint, even on the strong domain. The actual path is Y90 to D1, the eighth collector's Q0, G0, and X0. The late X0 sign at event **5086** is essential. The displayed D27 transient at 1817 to 1819 has no intervening direct reader.

The unchanged word has **728 Y writes, all bank-local native transports**. It cannot materialise the coupled K encoder under a direct one-bank-per-independent-coefficient identification, even after relabelling. All **104 final Y frames have dimension eight**, while the logical caller returns its coefficient fields in empty frames. External preparation, virtual coefficient access, and adapters remain possible, with an explicit physical contract and complete price.

## What changes

The current head is a mixed research-and-tooling submission, not a package-only archive. Its 32 changed files comprise 11 added files under `research/p104-kernel-consumer/` and 21 shared workflow, ledger, tooling, regression-test and historical-receipt files. The research package contains the written proof, local cost ledger, three complementary implementations, deterministic receipt, exact sources, task/overlap record, and registered replay commands. All 20 live inputs already belong to canonical main's ancestry.

The shared delta includes the P112 workflow parse repair (canonical focused proposal: #3885), community-tooling failure diagnostics, ledger closure-field preservation/reconciliation controls, pinned historical intake inputs, and explicit historical receipt replay adapters for the PR1 and PR636 source/credit receipts. Existing receipt README/SOURCES/VERIFY files are modified; shared tools therefore do change. These changes require substantive tooling review and must not be treated as package-only archival intake. The selected frontier and frozen scientific input hashes are not changed by this repair/consolidation work.

Two focused shared-tooling extractions are now published against refreshed canonical main: [ledger/reconciliation, 11 files](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/commit/1f360c63d00289aa5be2300d8c72e7bcf86827fe) and [historical receipt adapters, 9 files](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/commit/161ce1b96288349fd67ecda1734d2f96850a2ee9). The upstream draft proposals are [#4102 (ledger/reconciliation)](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4102) and [#4103 (historical receipt adapters)](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4103), published through the authenticated browser after the connected integration returned HTTP 403. Neither is a merged upstream repair. Following the ledger-only affected-package CI failure, #4102 now includes the unchanged nine-file #4103 patch through additive merge `1588e746871c5f1f197dbc034db2bfadbad0b646`, making #4102 a 20-file combined integration proposal. Both original extraction commits remain retained; #4103 remains the focused nine-file adapter review. This follow-up does not change this research branch or its evidence. The working repairs remain on this branch until an effective upstream/base path exists, so consolidation does not knowingly reintroduce broken tests. No force-push, rebase, upstream merge or scientific repinning is part of this correction.

The primary path reuses the authenticated PR #3467 K codec and a forward scalar/chart oracle. The separate literal interpreter imports no predecessor executable. A third implementation derives the reverse X0 row and compares all 104 Y coefficients against PR #3462's existing CA/2 certificate. It reuses the exact PR #3469 X0 adapter without rerunning or claiming those full completion/adapter theorems.

## Verification

The `4p` finite control completes all 5,398 events. It binds all 2,070 native occurrences, compares **102,656 completed signed-floor/ideal pairs** across 223 active native calls, and evaluates 1,847 zero calls by their exact zero action. All 3,104 ADDs, 208 signs, eight private zero erasures, 358 final frames, and the exact nonzero bank support are checked.

Complete-array comparisons cover the independently prepared 512-entry p, **9,216 Q0/G0/X0 checkpoint coordinates with frames**, and **1,024 returned Y coordinates**. The arbitrary normalised D1/Q0/G0 restoration rows are checked separately; the two literal fixtures have zero initial dirt. Dropping the late sign or Q0 cleanup gives the recorded separating failures.

Local registered normal and optimised Python 3.12 replays, metadata/pins, committed-byte/source-history, checked export, Git-free direct replay, and actual CLI rejection controls are the publication gates. The original public handoff records publication evidence for the earlier `33997335` head; it must not be read as an exact-head receipt for the later tooling-expanded branch. That retained evidence is not rewritten. The actual controls remove WORD, alter WORD, and substitute Boolean true for the integer receipt schema. Normal replay never regenerates evidence.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-kernel-consumer
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-kernel-consumer --check-source-history
```

## Scope, cost, and remaining obligations

This family lies in `S = (4B9)^52`, so it demonstrates **no advantage from L/S**. PR #3554's full caller returns all coefficient banks and retains their information. This result blocks access limited to the five readouts; it does not invalidate that logical routine.

The actual eighth collector costs 39,936 component ADD/SUB evaluations, with native halves, quarter turns, all four wrappers, owned C, and cleanup itemised separately. Three named later scalar updates add 3,072 component ADD/SUBs. A temporarily mutable quarter-read donor has its exact halves and restoring doublings charged; a read-only donor needs a separate implementation. These are local counts, not a complete physical or recursive invoice.

Actual coefficient production/access, all required outputs and frames, ownership, routing, control, zero supply, finite widths, and a favourable complete supplier allowance remain open. The inherited fixed-profile 599/584 stop remains conditional on its original premises. No supplier, new kappa, independent human review, or formal proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. No further construction is reserved without a named compatible caller and complete allowance.

The investigation's existing canonical claim is https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-19012530.
